subject: Future Tech
title: The Cryostat Challenge
description: A 60-second lesson on The Cryostat Challenge.

hook.text: Quantum chips must run near absolute zero. The dilution refrigerator that achieves this is an engineering marvel.

buildup.text: It works by mixing two helium isotopes. The mixing process absorbs heat, reaching about 10 millikelvin.

discovery.text: Building one costs over a million dollars. It takes days to cool down and days to warm up for repairs.

twist.text: The refrigerator itself generates vibrations. Engineers must isolate the chip from its own cooling system.

climax.text: Scaling up means fitting more qubits inside the same frigid space without adding unbearable heat or noise.

punchline.text: The coldest machines chase the hottest breakthroughs.

quiz.question: What temperature does a dilution refrigerator reach?
